description:
Property Home and Away have the pleasure in launching this impressive double fronted six bedroom, four bathroom family home in the much sought after Brompton Grove in Castleknock.
This is a 200SqM property and comes with a 24SqM detached block shed with tiled roof to rear . 
There are six-bedrooms, two with ensuite bathrooms, a family bathroom & downstairs toilet. You have three reception rooms, lounge, dining room, family room, music room, kitchen and dining area. 
This is a double fronted home which looks out to an open green space & has parking for four cars off street. The rear garden is south-east facing.    

Location is excellent, close to  Phoenix Park and all social amenities. There is a host of shops and restaurants close by. You are one kilometer from train station and have easy access to the N3 & M50, bringing you to the city & Dublin airport. Catchment area for primary & secondary schools is excellent. Viewing is strictly by appointment through Agent.


Accommodation

Kitchen  6.70 x 4.0   Extended Kitchen & dining area with copious amounts of fitted units & storage.

Lounge & Dining Room	8.34 X 3.46	Large family size living space with feature fireplace. Dual aspect windows in lounge and dining room bring natural light flowing in. 
 
		

Bedroom 1  3.64 x 3.57    Maple wood flooring, painted décor and ensuite.
